root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: The empty-PIN cleanup may execute `free(pincode)` only when `opt_pin == NULL`, i.e. only when `pincode` came from `get_pin()` rather than borrowed option storage.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: At the `if (pincode && strlen((char *) pincode) == 0)` cleanup in `change_pin()`, the branch truth that enables `free(pincode)` must agree with `opt_pin == NULL` so borrowed option storage is never released as owned heap memory.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original makes the empty-PIN cleanup free unconditional once the zero-length branch is entered, even when `pincode` still aliases `opt_pin`. The fixed original keeps the same empty-PIN branch reachable on the saved witness but makes the free-enable truth follow the missing ownership conjunct `opt_pin == NULL`.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: On the saved witness, the vulnerable original records `cleanup_free_enabled=1` and `opt_pin_is_null=0`, while the fixed original records `cleanup_free_enabled=0` and `opt_pin_is_null=0` at the same cleanup site. No perturbation was required because the fixed original still exercises the root cleanup event and directly satisfies the frozen predicate there.

nodes.state: At the ASan sink, `free(pincode)` receives the same `pincode` value carried to the empty-PIN cleanup site.
On the non-`env:` branch, `util_get_pin()` stores the caller-provided `input` pointer directly into `*pin` without allocating or copying, so the later `opt_pin` value is borrowed caller storage.

edges.relation: The same `pincode` value present at the empty-PIN cleanup guard is passed unchanged into `free(pincode)` on the next line.

The pointer value that `util_get_pin()` assigns directly from `input` to `*pin` later becomes `pincode` at the empty-PIN cleanup because `change_pin()` seeds `pincode = (u8 *) opt_pin` and skips `get_pin()` on the witnessed non-NULL `opt_pin` path.
